mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) potentiates amiodarone's cardiotoxic effects and increases risk of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity; both agents prolong QT interval and can cause electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), ECG/QTc interval, and hearing function closely; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on renal clearance.
